# Manuscript evidence (generated by `CaptionVQA/scripts/paper_evidence.py`)

## 1. Data flow of the QD caption corpus (from the `info` block of the dataset file)

| Stage | Model / version | Records |
|---|---|---:|
| train2014 questions | — | 443,757 |
| first pass: classification, generation, fast validation (blacklist 21,272, OCR 15,824, duplicates 88, empty 8, validation failures 250) | `qwen2.5:3b-instruct-q4_K_M`, classifier v20, generation v10 | 406,315 |
| reclassification (parse-failure fix) | `qwen2.5:3b-instruct-q4_K_M`, v20 | 283,707 |
| semantic screening (judge j2) | `qwen2.5:7b-instruct-q4_K_M` | ok 250,987 / WRONG 28,153 / GRAMMAR_ISSUE_ONLY 4,567 |
| regeneration of WRONG (2 rounds, T = 0.3) | `qwen2.5:7b-instruct-q4_K_M`, r2+genv10 | fixed 26,476, still WRONG 1,677 |
| final verdicts | — | ok 277,318 / GRAMMAR_ISSUE_ONLY 4,712 / WRONG 1,677 |
| **captioner training (verdict == ok)** | `train.py: load_qd_json` | **277,318** (79,568 images) |

- Remaining WRONG = 0.59% of the screened records (validator verdict, not a measured error rate).
- 29,844 ok rows carry the heuristic `suspicious` flag (reasons over all rows: {'extra_words': 29970, 'polarity_flip': 778}); the 7B judge passed them, they are used.
- Initial WRONG reasons: {'meaning_changed': 13577, 'answer_missing': 7376, 'answer_contradicted': 3156, 'added_facts': 1832, 'unrelated': 2212}.
